entries_span_ck.name: entries_span_ck
entries_span_ck.value: "entries"."end_at" is null or "entries"."start_at" is null or "entries"."end_at" > "entries"."start_at"

entries_end_needs_start_ck.name: entries_end_needs_start_ck
entries_end_needs_start_ck.value: "entries"."end_at" is null or "entries"."start_at" is not null

training_sets_span_ck.name: training_sets_span_ck
training_sets_span_ck.value: "training_sets"."ended_at" is null or "training_sets"."started_at" is null or "training_sets"."ended_at" >= "training_sets"."started_at"

goals_values_ck.name: goals_values_ck
goals_values_ck.value: ("goals"."target" = 'range' and "goals"."low" is not null and "goals"."high" is not null and "goals"."low" <= "goals"."high") or ("goals"."target" <> 'range' and "goals"."value" is not null)

template_blocks_own_ck.name: template_blocks_own_ck
template_blocks_own_ck.value: "template_blocks"."base_block_id" is not null or ("template_blocks"."kind" is not null and "template_blocks"."when" is not null)

template_blocks_shares_ck.name: template_blocks_shares_ck
template_blocks_shares_ck.value: ("template_blocks"."kcal_share" is null or ("template_blocks"."kcal_share" >= 0 and "template_blocks"."kcal_share" <= 1)) and ("template_blocks"."protein_share" is null or ("template_blocks"."protein_share" >= 0 and "template_blocks"."protein_share" <= 1))
